import unittest

from container.url_validation import normalize_http_url


class NormalizeHttpUrlTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_accepts_http_and_https_urls(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(normalize_http_url("https://example.com/a?b=1"), "https://example.com/a?b=1")
        self.assertEqual(normalize_http_url("http://example.com"), "http://example.com")

    def test_rejects_missing_or_non_http_urls(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            normalize_http_url("")

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            normalize_http_url("file:///etc/passwd")

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            normalize_http_url("https://")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# cloudflare-camoufox

Deploy [Camoufox](https://github.com/daijro/camoufox) behind Cloudflare Workers and Cloudflare Containers.

The Worker exposes two public API surfaces:

- `GET /playwright`: WebSocket endpoint for Playwright clients.
- `GET /content?url=<absolute-url>`: loads a page with Camoufox and returns the rendered response content.

Requests are load balanced across 10 Cloudflare Container instances by default.
Each Playwright WebSocket connection is assigned to one instance for the lifetime
of that connection.

## API

### Playwright WebSocket

```ts
import { firefox } from "playwright";

const browser = await firefox.connect("wss://<worker-host>/playwright");
const page = await browser.newPage();
await page.goto("https://example.com");
console.log(await page.title());
await browser.close();
```

If `API_TOKEN` is configured as a Worker secret, pass it as a bearer token:

```ts
const browser = await firefox.connect("wss://<worker-host>/playwright", {
  headers: {
    authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.CAMOUFOX_API_TOKEN}`,
  },
});
```

### Rendered Content

```bash
curl "https://<worker-host>/content?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com"
```

Default response shape:

```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "finalUrl": "https://example.com/",
  "status": 200,
  "headers": {},
  "title": "Example Domain",
  "content": "<html>...</html>"
}
```

Use `format=html` to return the rendered HTML body directly:

```bash
curl "https://<worker-host>/content?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com&format=html"
```

Optional query parameters:

- `wait_until`: `commit`, `domcontentloaded`, `load`, or `networkidle`. Default: `load`.
- `timeout_ms`: navigation timeout in milliseconds. Default: `30000`.

## Local Development

Install dependencies:

```bash
pnpm install
```

Run tests:

```bash
pnpm test
python3 -m unittest test_url_validation.py
```

Start local Worker and container development:

```bash
pnpm dev
```

Cloudflare Containers local development requires Docker.

## Scaling

The deployment is configured for 10 container instances:

- `CONTAINER_INSTANCE_COUNT=10` controls the Worker-side random routing pool.
- `containers[0].max_instances=10` controls the Cloudflare Containers instance limit.

Keep these two values aligned when changing capacity.

## Deployment

Deploy with Wrangler:

```bash
pnpm deploy
```

Set an optional bearer token before exposing the service:

```bash
wrangler secret put API_TOKEN
```

Then call `/content` or `/playwright` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

      libpango-1.0-0 \
      libx11-6 \
      libx11-xcb1 \
      libxcb1 \
      libxcomposite1 \
      libxdamage1 \
      libxext6 \
      libxfixes3 \
      libxkbcommon0 \
      libxrandr2 \
      libxrender1 \
      libxss1 \
      libxt6 \
      libxtst6 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

COPY container/requirements.txt /app/container/requirements.txt

COPY container /app/container

EXPOSE 8080 9222

CMD ["python", "-m", "container.main"]

import base64
import json
import os
import subprocess
import threading
from typing import NoReturn

import uvicorn

from .app import app


def build_playwright_server_options() -> dict[str, object]:
    from camoufox.server import launch_options, to_camel_case_dict

    options = launch_options(
        headless=True,
        host=os.getenv("CAMOUFOX_PLAYWRIGHT_HOST", "0.0.0.0"),
        port=int(os.getenv("CAMOUFOX_PLAYWRIGHT_PORT", "9222")),
        ws_path=os.getenv("CAMOUFOX_WS_PATH", "playwright"),
    )

    return to_camel_case_dict(
        {key: value for key, value in options.items() if value is not None}
    )


def run_playwright_server() -> NoReturn:
    from camoufox.server import LAUNCH_SCRIPT, get_nodejs

    nodejs = get_nodejs()
    data = json.dumps(build_playwright_server_options(), separators=(",", ":"))

    process = subprocess.Popen(  # nosec
        [nodejs, str(LAUNCH_SCRIPT)],
        cwd=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(nodejs), "package"),
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
    )
    if process.stdin:
        process.stdin.write(base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode())
        process.stdin.close()

    process.wait()
    raise RuntimeError("Server process terminated unexpectedly")


def main() -> None:
    threading.Thread(target=run_playwright_server, daemon=True).start()
    uvicorn.run(
        app,
        host=os.getenv("CAMOUFOX_API_HOST", "0.0.0.0"),
        port=int(os.getenv("CAMOUFOX_API_PORT", "8080")),
        log_level=os.getenv("LOG_LEVEL", "info"),
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from typing import Literal

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse

from .url_validation import normalize_http_url

app = FastAPI(title="cloudflare-camoufox")


@app.get("/health")
async def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok"}


@app.get("/content", response_model=None)
async def content(
    url: str = Query(..., description="Absolute http or https URL to load with Camoufox."),
    format: Literal["json", "html"] = "json",
    wait_until: Literal["commit", "domcontentloaded", "load", "networkidle"] = "load",
    timeout_ms: int = Query(30000, ge=1000, le=120000),
) -> dict[str, object] | HTMLResponse:
    try:
        target_url = normalize_http_url(url)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error)) from error

    result = await fetch_content(target_url, wait_until=wait_until, timeout_ms=timeout_ms)

    if format == "html":
        headers = {
            "x-camoufox-final-url": str(result["finalUrl"]),
        }
        if result["status"] is not None:
            headers["x-camoufox-status"] = str(result["status"])

        return HTMLResponse(str(result["content"]), headers=headers)

    return result


async def fetch_content(
    url: str,
    *,
    wait_until: str,
    timeout_ms: int,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    from camoufox.async_api import AsyncCamoufox

    async with AsyncCamoufox(headless=True) as browser:
        page = await browser.new_page()
        response = await page.goto(url, wait_until=wait_until, timeout=timeout_ms)
        content_html = await page.content()
        title = await page.title()

        return {
            "url": url,
            "finalUrl": page.url,
            "status": response.status if response else None,
            "headers": dict(response.headers) if response else {},
            "title": title,
            "content": content_html,
        }
